name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to reach the exit (the objective is to exit the room), but there is no hard goal clause guaranteeing `at_exit`. The current clauses only enforce rules and lack an `Existence(at_exit)` (or equivalent) hard clause, so the machine has no final state. Add a hard `Existence(at_exit)` clause (or a hard goal that forces reaching the exit) to capture the required goal.

texts: Each time the box falls, the agent must pick it up on the very next step
If the agent reaches the exit, it must be carrying the box at that moment
The agent must eventually reach the exit
